visualCharacteristics.summary: Loan APR/EMI calculator: five slider fields (loan amount, interest rate, tenure in months, processing fees, other charges) with synced number inputs and a Reset, and a result panel showing APR % and EMI amount. Client-side only.

contentPattern.structure: One row per item: optional heading; field rows [label | min | max | default | step] identified by label keywords (amount, rate, tenure, fees, charges); one-cell result label rows containing APR / EMI; a Reset row; link rows as CTAs.

usage: Loan APR/EMI calculator: five slider fields (loan amount, interest rate, tenure in months, processing fees, other charges) with synced number inputs and a Reset, and a result panel showing APR % and EMI amount. Client-side only.

notSuitableFor: deposit or investment calculators (use fd-calculator / investment-calculator)
